combat.damage.color.incoming.notes: Incoming color-tagged damage with exact raw fixture coverage.

combat.damage.color.outgoing.notes: Outgoing color-tagged damage with weapon and hit quality fixture coverage.

navigation.jump.notes: Navigation jump fixture coverage for Passive Telemetry routing.

notify.capacitor.insufficient.notes: Rejected lookalike for repair/healing; not combat repair evidence.

unknown.malformed.envelope.notes: Malformed envelope variants must reject before tactical parsing.

unknown.timestamp.missing.notes: Missing source timestamps are rejected; observedAt is not a substitute for eventTime.

unknown.timestamp.timezone.notes: Timezone-like timestamp suffixes are rejected until exact EVE log evidence exists.

unknown.timestamp.invalid.notes: Impossible dates and rollover timestamps are rejected.

unknown.oversized.notes: Oversized lines are rejected before parser matching.

combat.damage.color.near-miss.notes: Color damage lookalikes with unsupported colors or hit qualities are rejected.

combat.private.lookalike.notes: Private/fleet chat text that looks tactical is not combat-log evidence.

combat.repair.raw.notes: Rolling service supports normalized repair events, but raw parser support requires exact healing samples.
